collection.title: Hyundai Grandeur 2005 to 2026 windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: A Hyundai Grandeur 2005 Onwards model requires a 24" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 20" blade on the passengers side and all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. This model uses the Hook type arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm.
